title: The Heritage Stamp  (El sello de patrimonio)

segments.t: Veinte minutos después, en la habitación nueve, la inspectora de patrimonio ya ha revisado cada ventana, el cesto de libros y las tazas de té. Arthur y Hannah se reúnen con Evelyn junto al piano con una hoja blanca recién sellada en las manos. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
Saboreemos cada línea de esta victoria tan esperada.
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
'¡Evelyn! ¡Mira el sello azul redondo al pie de la página de Arthur!'
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
'¡Aprobado! Cafetería y Casa de Huéspedes Oficial del Patrimonio Vecinal: ¡contrato protegido!'
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
'¡Enhorabuena, Arthur! ¿Qué dijo la funcionaria sobre la habitación nueve?'
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
'¡Se bebió una taza entera de té de menta, se comió hasta la última migaja de tarta de limón y sonrió!'
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
'¡Dijo que restaurar una galería soleada oculta en la planta baja en vez de levantar tabiques era una genialidad!'
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
'¡Y Tessa, mirando con orgullo desde su cojín en el umbral de la cocina, lo vio todo!'
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
'Antes de que la funcionaria saliera a la calle Linden, preguntó si el piano de nogal funciona de verdad.'
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
'Tócalo para todos nosotros ahora mismo, Evelyn: ¡el "Vals del Patio" terminado de mi tía!'
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
'Abre de par en par las ventanas del patio, Hannah, para que Tessa y toda la casa puedan oír.'
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
'Ventanas abiertas de par en par, brisa de la tarde entrando. ¡Cuando estés lista, Evelyn!'
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
'Escuchen esas primeras cuatro notas saliendo flotando bajo nuestro árbol...'
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
'Por tu tía, Arthur, y por la habitación nueve.'
Escuchemos de nuevo esta escena llena de sol y de música.
Evelyn! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Arthur's page!
Approved! Official Neighborhood Heritage Cafe and Guesthouse: lease protected!
Congratulations, Arthur! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?
She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!
She said restoring a hidden first-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!
And Tessa watching proudly from her cushion at the kitchen doorway saw the whole thing!
Before the clerk walked out to Linden Street, she asked if the walnut piano really works.
Play it for all of us right now, Evelyn: my aunt's finished 'Courtyard Waltz'!
Open the courtyard windows wide, Hannah, so Tessa and the whole house can hear.
Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in. Whenever you are ready, Evelyn!
Listen to those first four notes floating out under our tree...
For your aunt, Arthur, and for Room Nine.
La tinta azul del sello se seca en el certificado, el contrato está a salvo y el 'Vals del Patio' suena por primera vez a través de los ventanales abiertos. Hasta la próxima.
Goodbye!
